rationale: The company is loss-making in the current period (profit before tax is negative), so profit before tax is not an appropriate benchmark under ASA 320 A5; revenue is stable and is the most relevant measure of the activity of the business. A percentage of 1% is the example given in ASA 320 A8 for revenue and sits at the top of the configured revenue range.
counter_argument: A percentage at the lower end of the range (0.5%) would be more conservative and would flag more accounts for attention, but with revenue of AUD 3,243,100.00 the 1% threshold of AUD 32,431.00 is already low relative to the size and number of movements, and 0.5% would produce the same nine accounts while adding no discrimination.
